items.title: Wells Fargo (WFC) Stock Still Looks Undervalued Following Its 99% Run
items.summary: Wells Fargo has seen its stock nearly double over the past three years, even as more recent returns have softened. This puts a spotlight on whether the current price still lines up with the returns the bank earns on its capital. With fresh headlines around outages, wealth management departures and growing exposure to Bitcoin ETFs, investors are being pushed to reassess how much return on capital this bank really needs to deliver to support where the shares trade today.
